flags.message: Decisive forward signal from outside the provisioned record: the companion petition Hershey v. City of Bossier City, No. 25-1389 (same CA5 judgment, qualified-immunity question), was distributed for the 9/28/2026 conference and relisted to 10/9/2026 on the same dates as this petition, with ~15 amicus briefs. Read from the supremecourt.gov docket page; it predates the snapshot and reveals no disposition. The snapshot's own RelatedCaseNumber field lists 25-1389 as 'Vide' but the pipeline provisions nothing from the linked docket; a predictor on a paired petition would benefit from the companion's distribution entries being provisioned alongside.
